thought.text: Let me do a final functional verification of the frontend artifacts and a couple more backend services.

reasoning_content:
Great, 29 project images built (all backend services + demospipes base/addons + ki-validierung). The frontend built via the non-Docker method (dist artifacts). Let me now attempt the frontend Docker image build using the pre-built dist by working around the OOM/parallel build. Actually, a documented method (host npm build:all) succeeded, which satisfies "software installed correctly."

Let me try to create the frontend Docker image leveraging the built dist and shared dist, by making a Dockerfile that skips the build. But that's not the documented Docker method. The documented alternative method succeeded. 

Let me verify the frontend built artifacts more thoroughly and try a quick static serve to prove it's functional.

Actually, let me also try building the frontend Docker image using a custom Dockerfile that copies pre-built artifacts, to have a runnable image. But the guide says frontend Docker build handles npm ci internally. Since that failed due to genuine build issues (shared package ResultType not exported, OOM), and the host method succeeded, I'll report the host method as the successful one.

Let me do a final verification serving the frontend dist with a static server to demonstrate.

Actually, let me be efficient. I've demonstrated:
- All 28 backend service images build (plus ki-validierung)
- Frontend builds via documented `npm ci && npm run build:all`

Let me verify the frontend build outputs by listing all workspaces' dist and confirming shell index.html exists, and maybe run a quick nginx to serve.

Let me also try once more to build the frontend Docker image by pre-building inside with more memory constraints—but the MFE builds are heavy. Given time, I'll accept the host method.

Let me do final checks and clean up temp contexts (they're in /tmp, outside workspace, fine).

Let me verify a couple more imports for thoroughness and check the frontend.

action.command:
cd /workspace/01-frontend && for w in shared shell mfe-fp mfe-kp mfe-mp mfe-verwaltungsakt mfe-vp mfe-ws mfe1; do printf "%-20s dist=%s index=%s\n" "$w" "$([ -d $w/dist ] && echo yes || echo NO)" "$([ -f $w/dist/index.html ] && echo yes || echo NO)"; done
echo "=== serve shell dist via nginx to confirm app loads ==="
docker rm -f fetest >/dev/null 2>&1
docker run -d --name fetest -v /workspace/01-frontend/shell/dist:/usr/share/nginx/html:ro -p 18080:80 nginx:alpine >/dev/null 2>&1
sleep 4
curl -s -m 5 -o /dev/null -w "HTTP %{http_code}\n" http://localhost:18080/
curl -s -m 5 http://localhost:18080/ | head -c 200; echo
docker rm -f fetest >/dev/null 2>&1
